Package com.robojacks.lib.hal.hydrozoa

Class HydrozoaHardware

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.hal.hydrozoa.HydrozoaHardware
All Implemented Interfaces:
Hardware
public class HydrozoaHardware extends Object implements Hardware
The real brain, through the Hydrozoa SDK. This is the ONLY file that imports Hydrozoa. Robot code never sees it: HydrozoaRuntime.start(java.util.function.Supplier<com.robojacks.lib.robot.VexRobot>) sets it up.

Device errors (unplugged motor, robot disabled by field control) never crash the program. Commands to a missing device are skipped and reported once over serial, and sensors keep returning their last good value.
